titulo: Giuliani says Mamdani should skip 9/11 ceremony during rant against Islam
cuerpo: New York City mayor confirms he will attend memorial service but declines to respond to Giuliani’s remarks New York mayor Zohran Mamdani is set to come face-to-face with Rudy Giuliani at the main September 11 memorial service, just days after the former mayor – who led the city at the time of the 2001 terrorist attacks – disparaged his Muslim religion and said he should skip the ceremony. In an interview with right-leaning Newsmax at the weekend, Giuliani said : “Having lost friends there and being very close to many of the families, it offends me that he’s coming.” Continue reading...
